EventRecord.title: EventRecord
EventRecord.description: Published event record: immutable content plus the SHA-256 of its canonical JSON (the exact-revision content address).

EventContent.title: EventContent
EventContent.description: Immutable content of one logged event: stream, sequence, tenant scope, actor, causal parent, typed payload, and the producer-supplied occurrence instant.

EventLogRecordVersion.title: EventLogRecordVersion
EventLogRecordVersion.description: Version discriminator carried by every serialized event-log record and snapshot (currently 1).

EventStreamId.title: EventStreamId
EventStreamId.description: Opaque event stream identity: the unit of total order; every event in a stream carries a contiguous 1-based sequence.

EventSequence.title: EventSequence
EventSequence.description: One event sequence number: 1-based, strictly contiguous per stream (the stream cursor).

EventTenantId.title: EventTenantId
EventTenantId.description: Opaque tenant scope of an event: "tenant:" followed by a lowercase slug (W009 grammar).

EventActor.title: EventActor
EventActor.description: Opaque acting principal of an event: "principal:" followed by a lowercase slug (W009 grammar).

CausalEventReference.title: CausalEventReference
CausalEventReference.description: Causal parent of an event: an appended event of any stream (cross-stream references are how streams intersect).

EventPayload.title: EventPayload
EventPayload.description: Typed event payload: namespaced discriminator plus opaque JSON data (kernel payload contracts for reserved namespaces).

EventKindDiscriminator.title: EventKindDiscriminator
EventKindDiscriminator.description: Namespaced event-kind discriminator selecting the payload data contract; the "world" and "action" namespaces are kernel-reserved.

EventData.title: EventData
EventData.description: Opaque JSON data of an event payload; the discriminator selects its interpretation.

Timestamp.title: Timestamp
Timestamp.description: UTC instant in canonical form YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.mmmZ (exactly three fractional digits, Z suffix).
